desc:
NEW: THE WEEVIL WAGON UPDATE!

Swat, stomp and spray your way through a pixel world full of bugs. Or drop a fat toad in and watch it gulp them down.

Squish them all... or catch them with a cup and set them free. Your call.

🛒 WEEVIL WAGON: 3 OP items, a new shelf every 2 days
🗺️ 4 new rooms: Busy Street, Pendulum Clock, Orchard, Piano Keys
🐛 4 new bugs and 7 free new tools, powers and critters
⏰ Terrarium events every 45 min, plus free gifts as you play

CODES: BUGS, CREEPYCRAWLY (enter them in the SHOP)

🐞 26 bugs: roaches, ants, ladybugs, bees, mantises and more
🧰 127 tools: swatters, slippers, giant boots and bug spray
🌩️ 99 powers: thunderstorms, frog rain, killer hornets and more
🗺️ 21 rooms, from a picnic to the moon
🐚 112 shells to dress your bugs in
👥 Play with friends in your room
📖 Fill your BUG-DEX and climb the boards

Right click: swat (hold to spray) · Left click: grab
1-0 / Q E: pick a tool · Space: freeze · G: slow-mo
Z: undo · P: photo · F1: every key
